bca_job_augmentor_drone_engineering_research_base = {
    modifier = {
        add = 1.75
        OR = {
            is_cyborg_empire = yes
            owner = {
                has_valid_civic = civic_machine_assimilator
            }
        }
    }
}
# -- 乘数链 --


bca_job_augmentor_drone_engineering_research_mult = {
    base = 1
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_productive_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_complex_and_simple_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_complex_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_engineering_research_produces_mult
}
# -- 每 1 workforce 产出 --


bca_job_augmentor_drone_engineering_research_per_worker = {
    add = value:bca_job_augmentor_drone_engineering_research_base
    add = modifier:planet_augmentors_engineering_research_produces_add
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_engineering_research_produces_add
    mult = value:bca_job_augmentor_drone_engineering_research_mult
    divide = 100
}

    }

        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -2.0
        colony = {
            bureaucrat_is_sacred_path_specialist = yes
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        colony = {
            bureaucrat_is_low_tech_manager = yes
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        colony = {
            bureaucrat_is_low_tech_priest = yes
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        colony = {
            bureaucrat_is_numistic_priest = yes
        }

        exists = owner

            is_spiritualist = yes
        }

bca_job_dystopian_telepath_physics_research_base = {
    modifier = {
        add = 1.5
        exists = owner
        owner = {
            has_country_flag = whisperers_covenant_confirmed
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = 1.5
        exists = owner
        owner = {
            has_country_flag = whisperers_covenant_rank_1
        }
    }
}
# -- 乘数链 --


bca_job_dystopian_telepath_physics_research_mult = {
    base = 1
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_productive_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_complex_and_simple_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_ruler_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_physics_research_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_telepaths_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_telepaths_physics_research_produces_mult
}
# -- 每 1 workforce 产出 --


bca_job_dystopian_telepath_physics_research_per_worker = {
    add = value:bca_job_dystopian_telepath_physics_research_base
    add = modifier:planet_telepaths_physics_research_produces_add
    add = modifier:planet_enforcers_physics_research_produces_add
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_physics_research_produces_add
    mult = value:bca_job_dystopian_telepath_physics_research_mult
    divide = 100
}

    add = modifier:planet_jobs_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_productive_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_complex_and_simple_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_specialist_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_alloys_produces_mult
}
# -- 每 1 workforce 产出 --


bca_job_engineer_alloys_per_worker = {
    add = value:bca_job_engineer_alloys_base
    add = modifier:planet_engineers_alloys_produces_add
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_alloys_produces_add
    mult = value:bca_job_engineer_alloys_mult
    divide = 100
}

    base = 6.0
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        owner = {
            is_robot_empire = yes
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = 2.0
        farmer_is_titan_hunter_trigger = yes
    }
}
# -- 乘数链 --


bca_job_farmer_food_mult = {
    base = 1
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_productive_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_complex_and_simple_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_worker_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_food_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_farmers_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_farmers_food_produces_mult
}
# -- 每 1 workforce 产出 --


bca_job_farmer_food_per_worker = {
    add = value:bca_job_farmer_food_base
    add = modifier:planet_farmers_food_produces_add
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_food_produces_add
    mult = value:bca_job_farmer_food_mult
    divide = 100
}

bca_job_foundry_energy_base = {
    modifier = {
        add = 0
        check_modifier_value = {
            modifier = planet_metallurgists_energy_produces_add
            value > 0
        }
    }
}
# -- 乘数链 --


bca_job_foundry_energy_mult = {
    base = 1
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_productive_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_complex_and_simple_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_specialist_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_energy_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_metallurgists_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_metallurgists_energy_produces_mult
}
# -- 每 1 workforce 产出 --


bca_job_foundry_energy_per_worker = {
    add = value:bca_job_foundry_energy_base
    add = modifier:planet_metallurgists_energy_produces_add
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_energy_produces_add
    mult = value:bca_job_foundry_energy_mult
    divide = 100
}

        add = 0
        check_modifier_value = {
            modifier = planet_farmers_society_research_produces_add
            value > 0
        }
    }
}
# -- 乘数链 --

    base = 1
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_productive_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_complex_and_simple_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_worker_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_society_research_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_farmers_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_farmers_society_research_produces_mult
}
# -- 每 1 workforce 产出 --


bca_job_peasant_society_research_per_worker = {
    add = value:bca_job_peasant_society_research_base
    add = modifier:planet_farmers_society_research_produces_add
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_society_research_produces_add
    mult = value:bca_job_peasant_society_research_mult
    divide = 100
}

bca_job_technophant_food_base = {
    modifier = {
        add = 0
        check_modifier_value = {
            modifier = planet_bureaucrats_food_produces_add
            value > 0
        }
    }
}
# -- 乘数链 --


bca_job_technophant_food_mult = {
    base = 1
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_productive_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_complex_and_simple_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_ruler_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_food_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_bureaucrats_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_bureaucrats_food_produces_mult
}
# -- 每 1 workforce 产出 --


bca_job_technophant_food_per_worker = {
    add = value:bca_job_technophant_food_base
    add = modifier:planet_bureaucrats_food_produces_add
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_food_produces_add
    mult = value:bca_job_technophant_food_mult
    divide = 100
}
